text:
Silver Price in 1985
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1985, the LBMA silver price fell 8.4% between 1985-01-31 ($6.33) and 1985-12-31 ($5.80). The highest sampled price was $6.66 in March and the lowest was $5.72 in February. The mean of these observations was $6.16. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
